svg.title: The last year of GitHub activity as a night sky: 1,427 contributions · busiest day 88 · longest streak 11 days
svg.desc: A star map of nayots's GitHub contributions for the year to 8 nov 2026: one star per day arranged in an arcing band, brighter for busier days, gold four-point stars on the five busiest days, the longest streak drawn as a gold line, and the most recent day pulsing at the right end. 1,427 contributions · busiest day 88 · longest streak 11 days.
